description: This Java source file defines a test or sandbox class 'EcuStimulatorSandbox' used for testing or demonstrating the 'EcuStimulator' interface in a UI context. It extends 'FrameHelper' to facilitate graphical frame display and contains a main method that displays the ECU simulator's UI panel.

classes.name: EcuStimulatorSandbox
classes.description: A sandbox/test class that creates and displays the ECU stimulator UI panel.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the sandbox application, initializes and displays the ECU stimulator UI panel.
